edition.tagline: The Dude abides. So does the White Russian.
edition.cue: Serve a White Russian every time the Dude makes one.

s.note: Corn chips with creamy cheddar sauce, mustard powder and sliced jalapeños.
s.how: Warm 120ml evaporated milk gently in a saucepan. Stir in 100g grated cheddar and 1/4 tsp mustard powder until smooth, without boiling. Divide 150g corn chips between four cardboard food trays, spoon over the sauce and add 30g sliced pickled jalapeños. Serve immediately.

s.note: Crisp striped lavash with paprika, cumin and sesame seeds.
s.how: Cut 2 lavash sheets into 12 rectangles. Brush with 1 tbsp olive oil. Sprinkle 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp ground cumin and 10g sesame seeds in alternating stripes to resemble a rug. Bake at 180°C conventional for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp. Cool before serving.

m.note: Double smashed beef patties with cheese, onion, pickles and crisp chips.
m.how: Cut 600g potatoes into chips, rinse and dry thoroughly. Blanch in neutral oil at 140°C for 5 minutes, drain and cool 15 minutes, then fry again at 185°C for 3 minutes until crisp. Season with salt. Divide 700g beef mince into 8 loose balls. Smash thin on a hot griddle, season and cook 2 minutes per side until cooked through. Melt 120g American-style cheese over the patties. Toast 4 burger buns. Mix 60g mayonnaise, 20g tomato sauce and 10g mustard for burger sauce. Fill each bun with two patties, 1 thinly sliced onion, 80g dill pickles and sauce. Serve chips alongside.

w.note: Brown butter chocolate chip cookies with a glass of cold milk.
w.how: Cook 80g butter over medium heat for 5 minutes until the milk solids turn golden and smell nutty. Cool until lukewarm. Mix with 80g brown sugar, 1 egg and 1/2 tsp vanilla extract. Fold in 130g plain flour, 1/4 tsp bicarbonate of soda and 80g chocolate chips. Refrigerate the dough overnight. Shape into 8 balls and bake at 180°C conventional for 11 minutes until the edges set and centres remain soft. Cool on the tray for 10 minutes. Serve two cookies each with 100ml cold full cream milk.

d.note: Vodka and coffee liqueur over ice, topped with thick cream.
d.how: Divide 400g ice among four rocks glasses. Add 45ml vodka and 20ml coffee liqueur to each. Top each with 30ml thickened cream and stir lazily. Totals are 180ml vodka, 80ml coffee liqueur and 120ml cream. Serve one prepared drink per person.
